english_text_found_page_1: Wipe clean using a damp cloth and mild detergent.
Warning: do not use the Rain shield on the BeSafe iZi Go inside the car.

page_2_text: CJK translations of the same warning, cleaning, contents and warranty lines (Japanese, Korean, Chinese); same product name 'BeSafe iZi Go'.
findings: The manual names only 'BeSafe iZi Go' (no Modular / X1 / X2 / i-Size, no article number). It therefore does NOT confirm that the rain shield fits 'iZi Go Modular X1' or 'iZi Go Modular X1 i-Size' as separate models, and it contains no model list from which X2 could be 'absent' or 'excluded'.

The one safety sentence is a USE restriction ('do not use ... inside the car'), not a compatibility list. Whether it applies to Modular X1 is a model-identity question for a human; no generation transfer was made.
Article number 11006001 / catalog SKU 11006001par are not present in this PDF; the SKU binding needs another OEM source (product page) -- see additional_documents_to_find in the worklist.
